stations.title: Dorrit
stations.say: Who lets go of the carriage clock?

stations.title: Two lists
stations.text: Bench and waiting list hold it at once.

stations.title: The laptop
stations.text: The repair ends when the last list goes.

captions: The carriage clock waits for a part, on Kasimir's bench and Dorrit's list at once.
When Dorrit takes it off her list, Kasimir's bench loses the repair as well.
You let both lists share one repair, and count who still holds it.
Now the carriage clock lasts until the last list lets go, and then it ends.
Repairs live exactly as long as someone needs them, whoever lets go last.
